title: In silico Analysis of Natural Inhibitors against HPV E6 Protein.
authors: Vani, Vemula; Venkateshappa, Snehalatha; Nishitha, Rachel; Shashidhar, Hima; Hegde, Arpitha B; Alagumuthu, Manikandan
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选HPV E6蛋白的天然小分子抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作建模，但对象为病毒蛋白而非TF-DNA体系，且无AI方法，仅部分方法可迁移。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Drug re-purposing is one of the cost-effective methods to establish novel therapeutics against many diseases. Established natural products are collected from databases and used to potentially screen them against HPV E6 protein, a critical viral protein. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to design potential small molecule inhibitors against HPV E6 protein using structure-based approaches. Ten natural anti-cancerous compounds (Apigenin, Baicalein, Baicalin, Ponicidin, Oridonin, Lovastatin, Triterpenoid, Narirutin, Rosmarinic Acid, and Xanthone) were selected by review of the literature. METHODS: These compounds were screened using Lipinski Rule of Five. Out of ten compounds, seven were found to satisfy Rule of five. Docking of these seven compounds was carried out using AutoDock software and corresponding Molecular Dynamics Simulations were performed by GROMACS. RESULTS: Among the seven compounds docked with the E6 target protein, six compounds showed lesser binding energy than the reference compound, Luteolin. The three-dimensional structures of E6 protein and the corresponding ligand complexes were visualised and analysed using PyMOL whereas the two-dimensional images of protein-ligand interactions were obtained by LigPlot+ software to study the specific interactions. ADME analysis using SwissADME software revealed that all the compounds except Rosmarinic acid have good gastrointestinal absorption and solubility characteristics while Xanthone and Lovastatin showed blood brain barrier penetration properties. Considering the binding energy and ADME analysis, Apigenin and Ponicidin are found to be most suitable for de novo designing of potential inhibitors against the HPV16 E6 protein. CONCLUSION: Further, synthesis and characterization of these potential HPV16 E6 inhibitors will be carried out and their functional evaluation using cell culture-based assays will be undertaken.
abstract_zh: 背景：药物再利用是开发针对多种疾病的新型疗法的一种经济有效的方法。已建立的天然产物从数据库中收集，并用于潜在地筛选它们针对HPV E6蛋白（一种关键的病毒蛋白）的活性。目的：本研究旨在利用基于结构的方法设计针对HPV E6蛋白的潜在小分子抑制剂。通过文献综述，选择了十种天然抗癌化合物（芹菜素 (Apigenin)、黄芩素 (Baicalein)、黄芩苷 (Baicalin)、冬凌草甲素 (Ponicidin)、冬凌草乙素 (Oridonin)、洛伐他汀 (Lovastatin)、三萜类化合物 (Triterpenoid)、柚皮苷 (Narirutin)、迷迭香酸 (Rosmarinic Acid) 和氧杂蒽酮 (Xanthone)）。方法：这些化合物使用利平斯基五规则 (Lipinski Rule of Five) 进行筛选。在十种化合物中，有七种被发现满足五规则。使用AutoDock软件对这七种化合物进行对接，并通过GROMACS进行相应的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟。结果：在与E6靶蛋白对接的七种化合物中，有六种显示出比参考化合物木犀草素 (Luteolin) 更低的结合能。使用PyMOL可视化和分析了E6蛋白及相应配体复合物的三维结构，而通过LigPlot<sup>+</sup>软件获得蛋白质-配体相互作用的二维图像以研究特定相互作用。使用SwissADME软件进行的ADME分析显示，除迷迭香酸外，所有化合物均具有良好的胃肠道吸收和溶解性特征，而氧杂蒽酮和洛伐他汀显示出血脑屏障穿透特性。综合考虑结合能和ADME分析，发现芹菜素和冬凌草甲素最适合用于从头设计针对HPV16 E6蛋白的潜在抑制剂。结论：将进一步进行这些潜在HPV16 E6抑制剂的合成和表征，并采用基于细胞培养的测定进行其功能评估。
